claims.claim: compile takes -c/--config, default config.arena.yaml
compile takes -o/--output, default <id>.pack.json
compile takes --id, default current directory name sanitized
missing parent directories of --output are created
--id is written to the pack id and name
explicit --id must match ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$ or the compile fails at the pack_id stage
default ID sanitization: lowercase, spaces to hyphens, strip others, collapse hyphens, pack- prefix, pack when empty
Arena config is a kind: Arena manifest; schema requires spec.providers and spec.defaults
arena prompt_configs entries take id and file
file paths resolve relative to the Arena config directory
prompt_configs/prompt_specs become prompts keyed by task_type
tools become pack tools keyed by name
pack_evals, workflow, agents, compositions reach the pack
pack_metadata becomes metadata; otherwise promoted from first prompt by ID with a warning
template_engine is the engine the prompts declare (PromptKit chooses it); disagreement fails the compile stage; none or the default are not compared; none declared gives v1
pack version is --pack-version or v1.0.0, description 'Pack containing <n> prompts'
compiled_with is packc-<version>, version as printed by packc version
success summary prints prompts, tools, evals, workflow, agents lines
compile runs the same checkPack checks as validate before writing
stage names pack_id, pack_version, load, compile, skills, workflow, compositions, agents, governance, pack, pack_schema
errors go to stderr as 'Compilation failed:' with [stage] message or numbered list; warnings '⚠ [stage] msg' on stdout
exit 0 success, 1 failure, 2 unknown flag
compiled pack template_engine includes features [basic_substitution] by default (page JSON sample)
an @org/name skill path stays a reference in the pack and resolves to the promptarena skill install directory
skills directory paths are made relative to the config file's directory for a relative or absolute -c
